g.aria-label: Step 1 (Ghost Sample S'): Replace Population Risk R(g) = E_{S'}[R̂_{S'}(g)]
Step 2 (Exchangeable Swap zᵢ ↔ z'ᵢ): Multiply Differences by εᵢ ∈ {±1}
Since zᵢ, z'ᵢ are i.i.d.: = E_{S,S',ε}[sup_g (1/n) ∑ᵢ εᵢ(g(z'ᵢ) − g(zᵢ))]
Step 3 (Split Suprema + McDiarmid Concentration): Factor of 2 Emerges
